cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 sets the inquiry order, A3 withholds questions until a decision, and A5 demands completion of B incriminating statement before A own.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 printer jam and smoke question cause A3 responsibility probe; B4 labels admission causes A5 to test whether misuse was knowing.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 repeatedly seek the smoke explanation while supplying printer information, making B a participant with competing urgency.

heightening.evidence: B4 admits using labels, and A5 raises the requested admission to disregarding a warning before yielding the floor.

specificity.evidence: A1 office kitchen and printer, B2 smoke and B4 sticky labels establish concrete incidents without requiring a causal link between them.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 finish-your-statement wording earns the status reversal; A3 repeats the ordering but remains playable within the pair word budget.

coach2.firstDefect: No mandatory defect found on the retained rereading; the nonspecific decision wording is a modest clarity reservation.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 uses B2 jam to ask culpability while refusing the requested turn.

A3-B4.evidence: A3 responsibility question causes B4 to admit using labels and ask permission to switch.

B4-A5.evidence: B4 labels admission leads A5 to ask about the warning and deny completion of the statement.
